parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' path hierarchy — a sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app boolean value. The duplicate of 'DebugMetricsProvider.measureMemoryUsage' in that file is almost certainly a self-contained debug utility copied into the sample app so it can run without depending on the production 'DebugPanel' package. Consolidating it into 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' would introduce a production-package dependency into a demonstration target, coupling sample-app semantics to production infrastructure. No refactor is warranted under the restraint rules.
